eyebrow: Who decides what counts as value
code:
Value = perceived benefit, usefulness, importance

Decided by:  the SERVICE CONSUMER
Not by:      the service provider's own sense of quality

A clever feature nobody asked for = low value
A clumsy fix that saves month-end close  = real value
caption: Value is perceived by the consumer, not engineered by the provider.

eyebrow: The question this principle hands you
code:
Before adding a form field...
Before writing a new KPI...
Before scheduling a recurring meeting...

Ask: "How does this benefit the service consumer?"

If nobody would notice it disappearing —
it isn't creating value. It's consuming it.
caption: One recurring question, applied constantly — not a one-time audit.
